demos.title: Survivors-style arena
demos.prompt: Build a Vampire-Survivors style bullet-heaven survival game as a multi-file web game. The player only moves; weapons auto-fire; endless waves of enemies swarm toward the player and scale up over time; killed enemies drop XP gems that level you up, presenting a CHOICE of 3 upgrades (new weapons or stat boosts); a survival timer and a boss at a time milestone. Hundreds of on-screen enemies should stay smooth.
